description: This file defines an interface for creating server request objects compliant with PSR-7 standards. It specifies the method signature for creating a new server request with specified HTTP method, URI, and server parameters.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactoryInterface
classes.description: An interface defining a method to create server request instances without parsing or processing server parameters.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new server request instance with the specified HTTP method, URI (string or UriInterface), and optional server parameters array.
